Good to know

Common questions

How much does a birthday photographer cost?
Birthday photography is usually booked by the hour. Australian pricing commonly starts from a few hundred dollars for short coverage. Requesting quotes is the best way to see real pricing.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
